decisions.reason: The trommel screen directly extends the firm's existing screening knowledge and has shown positive early feedback, so absorptive capacity supports continuous improvement and retention.
Mobile flail shredders build on the firm's core mobile shredding competence and dedicated product development, making withdrawal unlikely.
High-speed grinding is adjacent to existing shredding and material processing, and although early website presence was limited, the firm's R&D can assimilate and improve it.
The green-waste grinder leverages the firm's biomass and composting customer knowledge and related shredding capabilities, supporting ongoing learning.
Stationary single-shaft pre-shredders align closely with the firm's waste-processing and shredding know-how, allowing effective interpretation and improvement.
